```{r setup}
library(adorn)
```

adorn is a framework for writing decorators; it does not ship any. This
vignette defines a few common ones using only the public `decorator()` API, so
they double as examples for writing your own. Copy any of them into your own
code.

## timed

Call style (the wrapper has `...`): the body runs on every call.

```{r timed}
timed <- decorator(
  function(f, ..., digits = 3) {
    name <- decorator_context()$name
    start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    on.exit(message(sprintf(
      "%s took %s s",
      name,
      round(proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - start, digits)
    )))
    f(...)
  },
  name = "timed"
)

slow_add <- timed %@% function(x, y = 1) {
  Sys.sleep(0.1)
  x + y
}
slow_add(2)
```

## logged

`withVisible()` keeps functions that return `invisible()` quiet.

```{r logged}
logged <- decorator(
  function(f, ...) {
    name <- decorator_context()$name
    message("-> ", name)
    result <- withVisible(f(...))
    message("<- ", name)
    if (result$visible) result$value else invisible(result$value)
  },
  name = "logged"
)

double <- logged %@% function(x) x * 2
double(21)
```

Decorators stack; the one on the left is outermost.

```{r stack}
tracked <- logged %@% timed(digits = 2) %@% function(x) x * 2
tracked(21)
decorators(tracked)
```

## memoize

Factory style (no `...`): the body runs once, when the function is decorated,
so each decorated function gets its own cache.

```{r memoize}
memoize <- decorator(
  function(f) {
    cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
    function(...) {
      key <- paste(deparse(list(...)), collapse = "")
      if (!exists(key, envir = cache, inherits = FALSE)) {
        assign(key, f(...), envir = cache)
      }
      get(key, envir = cache, inherits = FALSE)
    }
  },
  name = "memoize"
)

fib <- memoize %@% function(n) if (n < 2) n else fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
fib(30)
```

## once

```{r once}
once <- decorator(
  function(f) {
    done <- FALSE
    value <- NULL
    function(...) {
      if (!done) {
        value <<- f(...)
        done <<- TRUE
      }
      value
    }
  },
  name = "once"
)

draw <- once %@% function() runif(1)
identical(draw(), draw())
```

## retry

```{r retry}
retry <- decorator(
  function(f, ..., times = 3, delay = 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(times)) {
      failed <- FALSE
      result <- tryCatch(withVisible(f(...)), error = function(e) {
        failed <<- TRUE
        e
      })
      if (!failed) {
        return(if (result$visible) result$value else invisible(result$value))
      }
      if (i < times && delay > 0) Sys.sleep(delay)
    }
    stop(result)
  },
  name = "retry"
)

attempts <- 0
flaky <- retry(times = 3) %@% function() {
  attempts <<- attempts + 1
  if (attempts < 3) stop("boom")
  "ok"
}
flaky()
attempts
```
